title: Structural Results on the HMLasso
content: HMLasso (Lasso with High Missing Rate) is a useful technique for sparse regression when high-dimensional design matrix contain a large number of missing data. To solve HMLasso, an appropriate positive semidefinite symmetric matrix must be obtained. In this paper, we present two structural results on the HMLasso problem. These results allow existing acceleration algorithms for strongly convex functions to be applied to solve the HMLasso problem.
